newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: China ammonia demand to reach 35.7 mln T in 2000.
newsitem.headline: China ammonia demand to reach 35.7 mln T in 2000.

text.p: China's demand for ammonia will reach around 35.7 million tonnes in 2000 while domestic production is expected to reach 34.6 million tonnes, a Chinese official said on Monday.
Chen Li, an engineer with the official China National Chemical Information Centre, said at an Asia ammonia conference in Singapore the shortfall would have to be met with imports.

The commissioning of new plants and expansion in the capacity of others will help China approach the "final target of self-sufficiency" in the supply of ammonia, Chen said. His office is a subsidiary of the Ministry of Chemical Industry.
China uses over 90 percent of total ammonia supply in the production of chemical fertilisers.

Chinese consumption of ammonia reached 33.97 million tonnes in 1995 while local production reached 27.64 million tonnes. The country imported about 6.33 million tonnes of ammonia to meet the supply gap.
